skill.name: uspto-database
skill.description: Search USPTO patent and trademark data, review examination history, and follow documented workflows for assignments, citations, and office actions.
skill.summary: Research USPTO patents, trademarks, prosecution events, ownership records, and related intellectual property data.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, official USPTO URLs, and placeholder key names. The clients make expected outbound requests and read USPTO_API_KEY, while the trademark CLI also accepts a command-line key that can leak through history or process listings. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found, but dependency pinning and request timeouts need improvement.

remediation.issue: The trademark CLI accepts API keys through --api-key.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the command-line key option. Use USPTO_API_KEY or a secure credential prompt that does not expose the value in process arguments.

remediation.issue: The PEDS dependency installation is unpinned.
remediation.suggestion: Specify a reviewed uspto-opendata-python version and provide a locked dependency file with integrity hashes.

remediation.issue: External HTTP calls omit timeouts and retry controls.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit connect and read timeouts, bounded retries, exponential backoff, and clear handling for HTTP 429 responses.

content.value_statement: Manual USPTO research requires several systems and query formats. This skill provides guided searches, helper clients, and reference workflows for patent and trademark analysis.
actual_capabilities: Search granted patents by keywords, inventor, assignee, date range, or CPC classification.
Retrieve patent titles, abstracts, dates, inventors, assignees, classifications, and citation fields.
Access PEDS application records, transaction histories, office actions, status summaries, and prosecution counts through a third-party library.
Retrieve trademark status by serial or registration number through the USPTO TSDR API.
Summarize trademark goods, owners, prosecution events, and basic status alerts.
Provide reference workflows for assignments, citations, office actions, PTAB matters, and litigation data.
limitations: PatentSearch and TSDR operations require network access and a valid USPTO API key.
The PEDS wrapper returns raw library data and may not match every assumed field.
The included HTTP clients lack request timeouts, retries, caching, and automatic rate-limit handling.
USPTO endpoints and coverage can change, and results are not legal advice.

use_cases.title: Run a Prior Art Search
use_cases.description: Search patent abstracts and classifications, then review matching titles, assignees, dates, and citations.

use_cases.title: Review Prosecution History
use_cases.description: Inspect application status, transaction codes, office actions, allowances, rejections, and pendency.
use_cases.target_user: Patent attorneys and IP operations teams

use_cases.title: Monitor Trademark Records
use_cases.description: Check mark status, registration details, owners, goods, services, and prosecution events.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One Patent
prompt_templates.prompt: Find USPTO patent {patent_number}. Summarize its title, issue date, inventors, assignee, abstract, classifications, and available citations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for a known patent number

prompt_templates.title: Search a Technology Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Search granted patents for {keywords} from {start_date} through {end_date}. Return the most relevant results with titles, dates, assignees, and CPC codes.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Trademark
prompt_templates.prompt: Review trademark {serial_or_registration_number}. Report its current status, filing and registration dates, owner information, goods, services, and recent prosecution events.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an IP Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the USPTO portfolio for {organization}. Combine patent, prosecution, trademark, assignment, citation, PTAB, and litigation data where available. Separate verified records from unavailable sources.

output_examples.input: Search machine learning patents assigned to Example Corporation during 2024.
output: Search criteria: machine learning, Example Corporation, January 1 through December 31, 2024.
Results list patent number, title, grant date, assignee, inventors, and CPC classifications.
A final note identifies missing abstracts, citations, or pagination limits.
The summary includes filing date, registration number, owner records, goods, services, and recent prosecution events when available.

output_examples.input: Review the prosecution history for application 16123456.
output: Current status and filing date appear first.
The timeline lists office actions, applicant responses, allowance events, and abandonment indicators.
The analysis reports non-final rejections, final rejections, total office actions, and estimated pendency.

best_practices: Store the USPTO key in the USPTO_API_KEY environment variable and avoid command-line secrets.
Narrow searches with dates, classifications, and requested fields before increasing result volume.
Verify important findings in current USPTO records and record the retrieval date.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a broad keyword search as a complete prior art or clearance opinion.
Do not hardcode API keys in prompts, scripts, notebooks, or version control.
Do not run large portfolio queries without rate limiting, caching, and pagination controls.

faq.question: Does this skill require a USPTO API key?
faq.answer: Yes for the included PatentSearch and TSDR clients. Set USPTO_API_KEY before using those scripts.

faq.question: Can it search patents by inventor or assignee?
faq.answer: Yes. The patent helper supports inventor, assignee, keyword, date range, and CPC classification searches.

faq.question: Can it review patent examination history?
faq.answer: Yes, through the uspto-opendata-python PEDS library. The wrapper can retrieve transactions, office actions, status, and basic prosecution counts.

faq.question: Can it search trademarks by name?
faq.answer: No. The included TSDR client retrieves records by serial or registration number, not free-text mark name.

faq.question: Does it provide legal conclusions?
faq.answer: No. It organizes public USPTO data and research workflows, but it does not provide legal advice or clearance opinions.

faq.question: Are assignment, PTAB, and litigation searches fully implemented?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents workflows and examples, but the included helper scripts do not implement every referenced API.
